preview: What would the small payout be at twenty eight cents a kilowatt?

messages.text: Looked up for Sarah: NerdOctaxe is $359.99, down from $499 — but the US/EU plug is out of stock right now; only the UK plug shows available.
Hey, I'm Sarah! I know every miner we carry, and I'm here to help. Adding to your setup, nice. What are you running right now? If you want to answer out loud, tap the mic, or just listen.
An assistant. I have the six or seven. Terahash, um, NERDEX.
Looked up for Sarah: NerdQaxe++ is 6 TH/s; the NerdOctaxe does 9.4 TH/s typical at about 160–220 watts, 12 only if overclocked.

Nice, a NerdQaxe at six terahash. The NerdOctaxe doubles that to twelve for three fifty-nine ninety-nine, down from four ninety-nine. Right now the UK plug version is the one in stock. Where will it be running?
Searched the catalog · Harlo B30 Magic Miner 40T
Looked up for Sarah: For a US address the NerdOctaxe US/EU plug is sold out; the step-up that is buyable is the Harlo B30, 30 TH/s at $899.

For a US setup, the real step up is the Harlo B30: thirty terahash, eight ninety-nine, ships November thirtieth. That's five times your NerdQaxe. And a quick correction: the NerdOctaxe runs about nine and a half terahash as it comes, not twelve. Twelve is only with overclocking, and its US plug is sold out anyway. Want to hear about the B30?
Is that a daily miner or a lottery wine lot minor?
Looked up for Sarah: Either: pointed at a pool the B30 stacks small steady sats; solo it's a block lottery ticket that keeps drawing. Don't quote sats numbers — none confirmed.

Honestly, it can be both. Point it at a pool and it pays out small, steady sats every day to your own wallet. Point it solo and every ten minutes it takes a shot at a full block, three point one two five Bitcoin. Which one sounds more like you?
What would the small payout be at twenty eight cents a kilowatt?
Looked up for Sarah: At 28¢, the B30's ~400W costs about $81 a month in power — more than the pool sats it stacks. No verified sats figure; don't invent one.
